patch.behaviour_review: init_mappings() in b12069 is identical to patched b11838 after applying; src/llama-mmap.cpp is identical between b11838 and b12069. With LLAMA_LAB_NO_MMAP_PREFETCH=1 and mmap in use, the initial whole-file PrefetchVirtualMemory is skipped and an INFO line is logged; demand paging, weights and the separate per-layer-embedding row prefetch (llama_prefetch_rows, present in both b11838 and b12069) are unchanged. Unset or any other value gives stock behaviour. llama-quant still calls init_mappings(false).
